description: Wind charges, snowballs and ender pearls thrown straight down at the floor, straight up, east at a stone wall at x = 8, and west into a two-deep water pool at x -6 to -3 (pearls only at the wall, into the pool and up, each a cooldown apart); a small fireball and a dangerous wither skull summoned flying east at z 5 into the wall (acceleration and inertia); then wind charges thrown 60 degrees down to the east with use and attack clicked every other tick, so the crosshair passes over flying wind charges.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

build: item replace entity @a hotbar.0 with minecraft:wind_charge 64
item replace entity @a hotbar.1 with minecraft:snowball 16
item replace entity @a hotbar.2 with minecraft:ender_pearl 16
harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
